document.name: HOMIO Frontend Execution Plan
document.purpose: Provide a durable, new-chat-safe implementation plan for the complete HOMIO F01-F13 frontend layer, with an India-first real-estate marketplace experience inspired by familiar Indian property-search information architecture while preserving HOMIO ownership of UX, implementation, brand, data presentation and interaction design.
document.scope: Production frontend implementation only. Covers F01 through F13, shared frontend engineering modules, India marketplace discovery UX, search and filtering, property and project exploration, save and compare, My HOMIO, contextual AI, enquiry and visit, transaction journey, professional SaaS, globalization, production quality, responsive behavior, accessibility, SEO, media governance and REOS integration boundaries.
document.experience_strategy: India-first launch experience with global extensibility. HOMIO should feel immediately familiar to an Indian property-search user, but the visual system, wording, interaction details, component implementation, media, information presentation and product identity remain independently authored by HOMIO.
document.reference_strategy: Use Magicbricks and other established Indian real-estate marketplace patterns as functional UX references only. Reproduce useful task flows and information hierarchy, not proprietary implementation, distinctive visual trade dress, text, logos, icons, screenshots, listings, user data or unlicensed media.

authority.master_architecture: REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/architecture/master/HOMIO_REOS_MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.json remains the canonical overall architecture and business authority.
authority.frontend_blueprint: REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/architecture/frontend/plans/HOMIO_FRONTEND_IMPLEMENTATION_BLUEPRINT.json remains the canonical frontend experience and UX architecture boundary.
authority.this_plan: This document is the canonical frontend coding execution plan, module registry, UI/UX execution registry and delivery sequence. It does not become a second architecture.
authority.project_state: REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/data/state.json remains the canonical project-state and execution-state authority.
authority.code: Git branch and implementation workspaces remain the canonical implementation reference.
authority.acrl: ACRL remains an engineering-time continuity, repository-intelligence, impact-analysis, diagnosis, repair and verification boundary. It is not a frontend runtime dependency.
authority.control_center: REOS Control Center remains authoritative for project execution, verification and approval state.
authority.chat: Chat is communication only and never becomes project state.

implementation_boundary.prototype_role: Visual and interaction reference only. It is not production architecture, canonical business data or a source of business truth.
implementation_boundary.approved_runtime: ARCH-038 approved Next.js, React, TypeScript and Node.js stack.
implementation_boundary.runtime_boundary: The browser consumes approved presentation-ready capabilities and does not read Control Center state, master architecture documents, ACRL repositories or backend source files directly.

india_marketplace_reference_architecture.architecture_impact: No change to Master Architecture business authority, tenant authority, governance authority, REOS ownership model or Control Center authority.
reference_basis: City, locality, project and landmark search
Post-property entry for authorized professional flows
forbidden_copying: distinctive page composition copied without independent design treatment
Magicbricks proprietary text or marketing copy
homio_ownership: HOMIO icons or licensed icon library

homepage.purpose: Get the user into a useful property search within one screen.
homepage.homepage_rule: The homepage must never feel like an architectural dashboard. It should feel like a simple consumer real-estate marketplace.

search_rules: Frontend does not score or rank canonical inventory itself.
Frontend may request approved sort or ranking modes but does not implement the search engine.
Every filter shown in production must map to a verified capability.
Unavailable filters are hidden or explicitly marked unavailable rather than simulated.

property_detail.detail_rule: Property detail should answer what it is, where it is, what it costs, what evidence is available, and what the user can do next.

market_and_locality.rule: Market information is display-only unless supplied by an authoritative REOS capability.

my_homio.purpose: One simple place to continue the user's real-estate journey.
my_homio.rule: My HOMIO aggregates canonical references. It does not create a second user-business database.

tools_and_advice.purpose: Expose useful decision-support utilities without turning the homepage into a cluttered portal.
tools_and_advice.placement_rule: Tools and advice remain secondary to discovery and search on the consumer journey.

professional_surface.purpose: Role-aware professional SaaS experience over existing REOS authorities.
professional_surface.rule: Professional navigation is role-aware and capability-driven; it does not duplicate backend domain engines.

design_direction.cards: Clear bordered or softly elevated cards with restrained radius.
design_direction.buttons: Clear primary, secondary and tertiary hierarchy.
design_direction.icons: HOMIO-owned or properly licensed icon system.
design_direction.imagery: Owned, commissioned or properly licensed property and city imagery.
design_direction.density: Medium information density on desktop; simplified density on mobile.

layout_rules: One clear primary task per page.
Search remains visually dominant on discovery screens.
Primary CTA is visually stronger than secondary actions.
Use whitespace to separate journeys, not to create unnecessary luxury styling.
Do not reproduce another marketplace's exact spacing or composition.
Responsive layout changes interaction model, not only width.
Do not hide important property facts behind decorative UI.

media_governance.remote_image_rule: Remote URLs may only be used when their licensing and production suitability are known and approved.
media_governance.fallback_behavior: If valid media is unavailable, render a controlled HOMIO placeholder rather than inventing or borrowing imagery.

production_structure.module_rule: One named production module maps to one source file for F01-F13 unless an explicit framework/config/test/generated-file exception exists.

SH02.name: Design System
SH02.purpose: Reusable visual primitives and accessibility-safe UI components.

SH03.name: Search and Filter UI
SH03.purpose: Presentation and interaction primitives for marketplace search.
SH03.rule: These are UI modules only. Search computation remains REOS-owned.

SH04.name: Navigation and Routing
SH04.purpose: Route composition, deep linking and safe context preservation.

SH06.name: REOS Binding Layer
SH06.purpose: Controlled frontend consumption of verified REOS capabilities.
SH06.rule: No adapter may invent a backend contract.

SH07.name: Security and Session
SH07.rule: Frontend visibility is never authorization authority.

SH08.name: Media
SH08.purpose: Safe responsive property and project media rendering.

SH09.name: Formatting
SH09.rule: Formatting never changes canonical business meaning.

SH10.name: Tools and Advice UI
SH10.rule: Calculators may be display or interaction helpers only unless an approved REOS capability owns the canonical financial calculation.

SH12.name: Observability
SH12.purpose: Frontend telemetry and diagnostics without becoming business truth.

F01.name: HOMIO Marketplace Experience Foundation
F01.goal: Build the India-first production marketplace shell, brand system, navigation, responsive primitives and reusable search UI foundation.
done_when: The application starts as a clean property marketplace.
Primary property-search intents are immediately visible.
Shell works on desktop, tablet and mobile.
The design is independently authored by HOMIO.
No business engine exists in F01.

F02.name: Home and Property Discovery
F02.goal: Create a familiar India-first property marketplace homepage that gets users into search quickly.
done_when: First-time user can begin search immediately.
Returning user can access meaningful continuation where approved.
Discovery sections remain visually subordinate to the primary search.
No mock business truth is shipped.

F03.name: Marketplace Search and Results
F03.goal: Provide the primary property-search experience with familiar filters and highly scannable results.
done_when: No frontend search engine is created.

F04.name: Property Detail Experience
F04.goal: Turn canonical property information into an easy decision experience.
done_when: Save and compare entry points exist.
Trust information is presented without becoming frontend authority.

F05.name: Projects, Collections and Localities
F05.goal: Connect property discovery to projects, collections, localities and market context.
done_when: Project and property navigation is seamless.
Locality and market content is traceable to approved capabilities.
No duplicate inventory ownership is introduced.

F06.name: Save, Compare and Search Continuity
F06.goal: Help users organize property decisions and return to active search context.
done_when: Compare focuses on meaningful property attributes.
No ownership or inventory logic is duplicated.

F07.name: My HOMIO
F07.goal: Give users one simple place to resume their real-estate journey.
F07.rule: My HOMIO aggregates authorized references and never becomes a second business-state database.
done_when: Journey state is traceable to canonical capabilities.
The frontend does not become the source of truth.

F08.name: Contextual AI
F08.goal: Provide grounded AI assistance inside property, search and comparison contexts.
forbidden: AI replacing a safer standard UI action
done_when: Grounding information is preserved where available.

F09.name: Enquiry and Visit
F09.goal: Turn discovery into controlled real-world action.
F09.rule: Frontend initiates authorized actions and displays authoritative results. It does not own lead, visit or communication truth.
done_when: Visit flow has loading, success, error and unauthorized states.
Duplicate submissions are prevented where appropriate.
User always knows what happens next.

F10.name: Transaction Journey
F10.goal: Expose authorized transaction progress without recreating the transaction engine.
done_when: Authorized transaction state is clearly displayed.
Milestones and next actions are grounded in REOS.

F11.name: Professional SaaS
F11.goal: Provide role-appropriate professional workspaces over existing REOS authorities.
F11.rule: Professional SaaS is an experience layer, never an additional domain engine.
done_when: Professional actions map to verified REOS capabilities.

F12.name: Globalization and International Expansion
F12.goal: Prepare the frontend for multiple countries, currencies, languages, units and local market conventions without breaking the India-first product.
forbidden: hardcoded country business rules in presentation components
done_when: India remains a first-class launch market.
Canonical business rules remain in REOS.

F13.name: Production Quality and Launch Readiness
F13.goal: Make the complete HOMIO marketplace frontend production-safe, responsive, accessible, measurable and maintainable.

MP01.name: Marketplace Shell Alignment
MP01.goal: Align the existing HOMIO foundation with a familiar Indian property-marketplace interaction model.

MP02.name: India Home Discovery
MP02.goal: Build the homepage around the same broad task sequence users expect from Indian property portals while keeping HOMIO's own identity.

MP03.name: Search Results System
MP03.goal: Build a powerful but simple property-results experience.

MP04.name: Property, Project and Locality Exploration
MP04.goal: Connect property details to project and locality context.

MP05.name: Decision Continuity
MP05.goal: Make save, compare and resume behavior feel natural across the product.

MP06.name: Intelligence and Action
MP06.goal: Add AI, enquiry and visit actions only after discovery flows are stable.

MP07.name: Professional Marketplace Workspace
MP07.goal: Extend familiar marketplace workflows into SaaS-grade professional tools.

copyright_safe_execution.rule_01: Functional similarity is acceptable only when independently implemented.
copyright_safe_execution.rule_03: All page copy must be HOMIO-authored.
copyright_safe_execution.rule_04: All visuals must be owned, commissioned or properly licensed.
copyright_safe_execution.rule_05: Do not scrape competitor inventory or media.
copyright_safe_execution.rule_07: Use competitor research for task-flow learning, not asset reuse.

frontend_owned_state: temporary optimistic UI where explicitly safe
frontend_state_model.persisted_user_state: Only through approved REOS capabilities or approved frontend persistence for non-authoritative UX preferences.

B01.frontend_role: search request/response presentation, filter UI and context preservation

B03.frontend_role: authorized action initiation and result presentation

rules: Do not simply shrink desktop UI.
Keep price, type, location and primary action immediately visible.
Use drawers or sheets for secondary complexity.

loading.rule: Use skeletons that preserve final layout shape.

empty.rule: Explain why the result is empty and offer the next useful action.

error.rule: Never hide failed data behind fake UI.
actions: continue with available content where safe

unauthorized.rule: Show safe sign-in or access-required states without revealing protected information.

coding_rules.rule_01: Before creating a module, check whether a shared module already solves the requirement.
coding_rules.rule_02: Feature modules own presentation and UX composition, not canonical business logic.
coding_rules.rule_03: Use adapters only for verified REOS capabilities.
coding_rules.rule_04: Do not create generic Manager, Service or Engine classes merely for naming symmetry.
coding_rules.rule_05: Do not mirror CORE-001 through CORE-008 structure inside frontend features.
coding_rules.rule_06: Do not import ACRL into production frontend code.
coding_rules.rule_07: Do not read state.json from the browser.
coding_rules.rule_08: Do not read Master Architecture JSON from the browser.
coding_rules.rule_09: Do not invent API endpoints because a UI needs data.
coding_rules.rule_10: A missing backend capability becomes a clear unavailable/error state, not a fabricated frontend implementation.
coding_rules.rule_11: Preserve user search and journey context wherever practical.
coding_rules.rule_12: Every action requires clear pending, success, failure and unauthorized handling where relevant.
coding_rules.rule_13: Mobile, tablet and desktop are intentional interaction modes.
coding_rules.rule_14: Accessibility is implemented with the feature.
coding_rules.rule_15: Prototype visual quality may be reused only as inspiration; prototype architecture is not production architecture.
coding_rules.rule_16: Marketplace familiarity must never become visual cloning.
coding_rules.rule_17: Do not copy competitor copy, imagery, logos, screenshots or proprietary assets.
coding_rules.rule_18: Do not use unlicensed remote image URLs in production.
coding_rules.rule_19: Every property card must answer what it is, where it is and what it costs before secondary information.
coding_rules.rule_20: Every search page must make the current search context visible.
coding_rules.rule_21: Every page must have one obvious next useful action.
coding_rules.rule_22: Secondary tools and advice must not visually overpower property discovery.
coding_rules.rule_23: If a capability is not verified, remove the interaction rather than simulate it.
coding_rules.rule_24: Keep consumer UX simple even when backend architecture is complex.

delivery_gates.G01: F01 marketplace shell complete and production build valid.
delivery_gates.G04: F04-F05 property, project and locality exploration functional.
delivery_gates.G05: F06-F07 save, compare and My HOMIO continuity functional.
delivery_gates.G06: F08-F09 AI, enquiry and visit flows functional.
delivery_gates.G07: F10-F11 transaction and professional surfaces functional.

f_layer_dependency_graph.parallelization_rule: Only modules with no unresolved shared dependency may be developed in parallel. Shared primitives and REOS binding boundaries must stabilize before dependent slices proceed.

then_check: current F-layer status in this plan
latest verified REOS capabilities required by the active F-layer
new_chat_bootstrap.continuation_rule: Resume from the first incomplete F-layer gate. Do not restart completed F-layers without evidence of regression.

Frontend does not create a second business architecture.
No duplicate canonical domain engine exists.
Frontend Blueprint remains the experience authority.
This execution plan remains the implementation authority.

PG and Plot discovery paths exist where approved.
Location, project and landmark discovery is clear.
Property type, BHK, budget and area filters are usable.
Property cards expose key facts clearly.
Project and locality context is discoverable.
Tools and advice are useful but secondary.
Mobile filter and action behavior is intentional.
implementation: F01-F13 are implemented according to this registry.
MP01-MP07 marketplace alignment work is implemented.
All production routes are intentional and verified.
Prototype is migrated without carrying monolithic architecture into production.
No competitor proprietary assets are embedded.
media_and_brand: Images and media are owned, commissioned or properly licensed.
